name: request-body-cap
prompt: main.go reads requests without bounding their size, so a client can send an enormous body and exhaust memory. Add a body cap: add const maxRequestBodyBytes = 1 << 20 (1 MiB) in main.go and add func boundedBody(r *http.Request) *http.LimitedReader that wraps r.Body in an http.MaxBytesReader-limited reader of maxRequestBodyBytes. Call boundedBody in the POST /session branch before any body handling, and when a request's body exceeds the cap, the handler must answer 413 Request Entity Too Large. Bodies at or under the cap proceed normally.
